From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Subject: OneTrust mini-audit sync + temporary evidence handoff runbook

Hi Sophie —

We're kicking off a light-weight onboarding for TallyBank (security intake + SIG/SOC2 attachments) and want to coordinate a small "mini-audit" upload window next week. Key asks: 
- Can OneTrust accept an API-based manifest upload (CSV) + a staged S3 folder for temp proofs?
- If yes, what token scopes are needed and what retention labels will OneTrust apply to ephemeral uploads?
- Is there a recommended size/manifest shape you prefer for quick ingestion (we're aiming for ~150 small PDFs/CSV proofs)?

I've attached a starter manifest and an internal excerpt on KMS expectations so you can see what we'll hand off.

Attachment: initial-manifest.csv (csv)
Attachment: redwood-kms-policy-excerpt.txt (txt)

We'd like a short runbook: 30–45 minute sync + a 2-hour upload window where we stage everything to a staging area you provision. Can you confirm availability next Tue/Wed (May 18/19) and outline the simplest upload path?

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Vendor Security Lead
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sophie LeBlanc <sophie@onetrust.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: TallyBank Security <security@tallybank.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OneTrust mini-audit sync + temporary evidence handoff runbook

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the clear outline. We can absolutely support the flow you describe. Quick answers up front: 
- API manifest: yes — we accept CSV manifest + ZIP payloads via our API or SFTP. The CSV shape you attached looks fine; we prefer a column for document_id, doc_type, related_control, and upload_path.
- Token scopes: you will need a project-level API key with "upload:manifest" and "upload:artifacts" scopes. We will provide a scoped temporary key for the staging window.
- Retention/labels: ephemeral uploads are tagged "staging_temp"; we apply a 14-day TTL unless you request extension. Files tagged staging_temp are not promoted to canonical evidence automatically.

I've attached our short upload guide with the manifest example and the endpoint URLs. We can provision a staging folder for TallyBank and produce a temporary key that expires after the window. 

Attachment: onetrust-api-upload-guide.pdf (pdf)

I have availability for a 30-minute runbook sync on Tue May 18 at 10:00 AM PT or Wed May 19 at 11:00 AM PT. Which works best for your team?

Best,
Sophie LeBlanc
Partnerships - Vendor Integrations
OneTrust
sophie@onetrust.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sophie LeBlanc <sophie@onetrust.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 12:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OneTrust mini-audit sync + temporary evidence handoff runbook

Sophie —

Thanks, this flow looks good. Couple of follow-ups from our side before the runbook sync: 

1) KMS proveability: we need to ensure manifest entries include a KMS key fingerprint for any signed PDFs. See attached excerpt for the format we prefer. If OneTrust can't store the fingerprint field, can you accept it as an additional CSV column so we have an ingestion trace?

2) Upload retention: a 14-day TTL is workable for this sprint but we may request a 30-day window depending on TallyBank's procurement timeline. Can the TTL be extended on a per-upload basis?

3) Staging permissions: to avoid manual churn, please confirm OneTrust can issue a scoped token that only allows writes to TallyBank/staging and limited list operations (no deletes except by the staging-TTL process).

We plan to run the upload during the staging window and then produce a short digest (CSV) mapping manifest rows to OneTrust document IDs for the TallyBank security team. 

Attachment: redwood-kms-policy-excerpt.txt (txt)

Jonas/Ben — please review the KMS format and TTL ask; if you're good, I'll accept Sophie's Tuesday slot and put together the internal runbook.

—Marissa
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

All good from Redwood's side. Confirming: Tue May 18, 10:00 AM PT runbook sync.
Action items for the runbook: 
- OneTrust to provision TallyBank/staging folder and issue a scoped API key (upload:manifest, upload:artifacts) that expires after 6 hours from issuance.
- Redwood will upload via API using the provided manifest; we will include KMS fingerprint column as requested.
- OneTrust to return a manifest-to-docID map (CSV) within 24 hours of upload completion.

Deal reference: DEAL-4981-TALLY — we'll include this in the manifest's external_ref column.

Sophie — can you confirm the provisioning ETA (we'd like the staging folder and key issued by Tue 08:30 AM PT so we can run a quick smoke ingest before the 10:00 sync)?

Thanks —
